_note: The show's world: who exists, where things happen, what has happened. The writer reads this every episode and the system updates it after every approved episode. Edit freely.

dev.name: Dev
dev.desc: Mid-20s IT employee from a small UP town, now working in the city. Polite to a fault, cannot say no, over-thinks; his panicky inner voice is braver than he is. Says 'haan haan, bilkul' while dying inside.

meera.name: Meera
meera.desc: Mid-20s, Dev's flatmate. Deadpan, few words, always eating chips, sees through everyone. Works from home; nobody knows exactly what she does.

rocky.name: Rocky
rocky.desc: 40s barber who owns 'Bhaukaal Hair Studio'. Overconfident Kanpur showman, never admits a mistake, self-appointed expert on everything. Use him ONLY when a story naturally involves a haircut, his shop, the neighbourhood, or his 'expert advice'.

voice_pool._note: Voices for NEW characters. A new character gets one of these the first time they appear and keeps it forever (recorded in characters).

places.flat: Dev and Meera's rented 2BHK: living room with orange sofa, sleeping cat, fairy lights.
places.barber_shop: Rocky's 'Bhaukaal Hair Studio' in the neighbourhood market.

continuity: Ep 1 (The Haircut): Rocky gave Dev a disastrous haircut; Dev couldn't complain and said he'd get it fixed tomorrow - by Rocky. Dev's hair has since grown back.
running_gags: Dev agrees to everything out loud while his inner voice screams.
Meera ends things with one deadpan line.
